title: MFlix 示例数据操作
description: 电影与评论样例的查询、新增、修改、删除、聚合和索引操作。

source.label: Hello Docker · MongoDB MFlix
source.note: 案例清单已更名；历史记录保留原清单哈希。所有输入、已有结果和运行脚本均已按原始记录核对。

examples.title: 电影数量
notes: 读取 movies 集合的估算文档数，用于了解已导入样例的规模。

examples.title: 电影筛选、排序与分页
notes: 筛选 Drama 类别、2000 年、IMDb 评分 7 到 9 的电影，按标题排序，取前 5 条。
查询与返回文档均来自这次已保存的采集记录。

tomatoes.consensus: A boozy depiction of a struggling writer, Big Bad Love is too messy and self-indulgent.

result.title: A Matter of Taste
result.fullplot: Nicolas, a handsome, young waiter, is befriended by Frèdèric Delamont, a wealthy middle-aged businessman. Delamont, a man of power, influence and strictly refined tastes, is immediately smitten by Nicolas' charm. Lonely and phobic, Delamont offers Nicolas a lucrative job as his personal food taster. In spite of their differences, a close friendship begins to emerge between the two men. However, their bond of trust and admiration soon spirals downward into a dangerous game of deceit and obsession for which neither is prepared.

result.plot: An old Jewish shop owner Mr. Shaddick ('Peter Falk') suddenly finds himself responsible for a little black boy named Herman Washington ('Aaron Meek') trying to escape the chaos of Harlem as...
result.title: A Storm in Summer
result.fullplot: An old Jewish shop owner Mr. Shaddick ('Peter Falk') suddenly finds himself responsible for a little black boy named Herman Washington ('Aaron Meek') trying to escape the chaos of Harlem as part of a sponsorship program. At first, Mr. Shaddick wants nothing more than to get rid of the kid, but to spite the well to do lady who tries to take him over to her home, he decides to take Herman in. As time goes on, Mr. Shaddick finds himself caring about Herman and has the misfortune of being the bearer of bad news, which reminds him of when he received a telegram himself.

result.plot: Young Iranian Kurds (brothers and sisters) try to save the youngest of them, who is seriously ill.
result.title: A Time for Drunken Horses
result.fullplot: After their father dies, a family of five are forced to survive on their own in a Kurdish village on the border of Iran and Iraq. Matters are made worse when 12 year old Ayoub, the new head of the family, is told that his handicapped brother, Madi, needs an immediate operation in order to remain alive. This heartbreaking tale shows the lengths to which a family will go in order to survive in the harshest of conditions, where even the horses are fed liquor in order to work.

examples.title: 电影类别去重
notes: 对 genres 字段去重，返回值是字符串数组，表格视图以单列展示。

examples.title: 按 ID 查询电影
notes: 通过 ObjectId 精确查找一部电影，返回单个文档。JSON 视图保留 ObjectId、日期等 Extended JSON 表示。

result.plot: A group of bandits stage a brazen train hold-up, only to find a determined posse hot on their heels.
result.title: The Great Train Robbery
result.fullplot: Among the earliest existing films in American cinema - notable as the first film that presented a narrative story to tell - it depicts a group of cowboy outlaws who hold up a train and rob the passengers. They are then pursued by a Sheriff's posse. Several scenes have color included - all hand tinted.

examples.title: 创建一部电影
notes: 调度器先创建空的临时练习库，再插入一部电影。结果展示写入确认和 insertedId。
临时库在采集结束后清理，原始 sample_mflix 数据保持不变。

examples.title: 批量创建电影
notes: 在空的临时练习库中批量新增电影，返回 insertedIds。练习库由采集脚本创建并清理。

examples.title: 更新一部电影
notes: 先准备临时练习数据，再修改一条匹配记录；查看 matchedCount 与 modifiedCount 的区别。

examples.title: 批量更新电影
notes: 对临时练习库中的多条记录执行更新，结果包含匹配数量、实际修改数量及 upsert 信息。

examples.title: 删除一部电影
notes: 从预先准备的临时练习数据中删除一条记录，通过 deletedCount 核对结果。

examples.title: 批量删除电影
notes: 批量删除临时练习库中符合条件的记录，已保存结果包含实际删除数量。

examples.title: 返回并删除电影
notes: 删除匹配记录并返回被删除的文档，结果形状与仅返回确认信息的 deleteOne 不同。

examples.title: 普通文本查询
notes: 在准备好的练习数据和文本索引上执行 $text 查询。普通文本索引与 MongoDB Search 使用不同的查询入口。

examples.title: 电影最新评论与评论数量
notes: 通过 $lookup 关联电影与评论，按日期整理最近三条评论，并保留评论总数。嵌套数组可在 JSON 视图完整查看。

examples.title: 按年份统计电影与评分

notes: 展开导演数组，按导演分组统计作品数量，再排序并限制返回条数。
